weapon.d: If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+5 to unit and neutralizes unit's penalties to Atk/Def during combat.
If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Def+5 to unit and neutralizes unit's penalties to Atk/Def during combat.

Effective against flying foes. Calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, and unit deals +20 damage during combat (including area-of-effect Specials).
Unit can use the following【Style】:
――――――― Range: 2 Style ―――――――
Unit can attack foes 2 spaces away (unit cannot attack adjacent foes).
Cannot move through spaces within 2 spaces of foe that has triggered the Bulwark effect (does not apply if unit has a Pass skill). Unit suffers a counterattack if any of the following conditions are met: foe is armored with Range = 1, foe can counterattack regardless of unit's range, or foe's Range is the same as the distance between unit and foe.
After-combat movement effects do not occur.
Skill effect's Range is treated as 1. This Style can be used only once per turn.
――――――――――――――――――――――――
【Style】
Change Style using the Style button at the bottom of the screen.
A unit's Style is only active when that unit is taking an action. Style use is disabled when unit is deployed using Pair Up or when unit is equipped with multiple skills that have a Style.

assist.d:
Restores 10 HP to target ally.
Unit loses 10 HP but cannot go below 1.

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Def+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Def+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Def+4 during combat.

b.d: If unit's HP = 100%, unit can move to a space adjacent to a flying ally within 2 spaces.
If unit's HP ≥ 50%, unit can move to a space adjacent to a flying ally within 2 spaces.
Unit can move to a space adjacent to a flying ally within 2 spaces.
